title: Fade to... Red? Scheduling Coloured Noise Exploration Supports Efficient Robot Learning with Reduced Movement Jerk
abstract: arXiv:2611.11868v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Exploration in deep reinforcement learning (RL) for continuous control is commonly driven by temporally uncorrelated Gaussian (white) action noise, which leads to jerky motions with locally constrained exploration. In contrast, temporally correlated coloured noise, particularly pink noise, has been shown to support more efficient exploration in RL. Motivated by these findings, we inquire whether scheduling changes to the noise colour over the course of training can outperform white noise for continuous control robotics. We perform a systematic study of 49 linear schedules between white and red noise, together with generalised state-dependent exploration (gSDE), on four sparse-reward manipulation tasks with a Fetch arm and a Shadow Dexterous Hand. translated_title: 淡出至…红色？调度有色噪声探索以支持高效机器人学习并减少运动抖动
translated_abstract: 深度强化学习（RL）在连续控制中的探索通常由时间上不相关的高斯（白）动作噪声驱动，这会导致动作抖动且探索局限于局部范围。相比之下，时间上相关的有色噪声，尤其是粉红噪声，已被证明能支持更高效的RL探索。受这些发现的启发，我们探究在训练过程中调度噪声颜色的变化能否在连续控制机器人任务中优于白噪声。我们在使用Fetch机械臂和Shadow灵巧手的四个稀疏奖励操作任务上，对白噪声与红噪声之间的49种线性调度方案结合广义状态相关探索（gSDE）进行了系统性研究。我们发现训练结束时的噪声颜色并不影响学习效率或最终性能，而向红噪声渐变则在每个任务中将探索的动作抖动减半……
tldr: 在机器人强化学习训练中，将探索噪声从白噪声逐渐过渡到红噪声（有色噪声），可在不损失学习效率和最终性能的前提下，将探索动作的抖动减半，实现更平滑高效的学习。
en_tdlr: Scheduling exploration noise color to fade from white to red during RL training halves movement jerk in every robotic manipulation task without compromising learning efficiency or final performance.
